visual_summary: In a vast industrial chamber full of pipes, fire, smoke, and shallow liquid, two large floating polyhedral halves hover inside bright energy halos. One speaker urgently orders another to activate specific circuit reactors so the halves can rejoin before falling into an acid lake. The lower panels show the halves aligning and descending together amid damage and flames, while many tiny ant-like repair robots swarm over the machinery and discuss what they have witnessed.
